candidates.name: xs-ra-sequential-v1
candidates.hypothesis: Admit physical xswap readahead only after adjacent virtual fault addresses; discontinuous faults retain synchronous single-folio reads. Preserve sequential mean gains while eliminating prior random p99 regression; falsified by any calibrated latency guard failure.
candidates.decision_reason: REGRESSION in fast report 49add9b084d04941a459281838bbf3f3: disk seq p99 and rand p99 fail. swap_ra=0 in both candidate disk runs; source VMA-only admission is inactive with the rotational guest backend. Keep failed evidence; no causal speed claim, slow run or promotion.

candidates.name: xs-zswap-linear-v1
candidates.hypothesis: Copy only split compressed zsmalloc objects into the existing mutex-owned buffer for synchronous transforms, exposing contiguous input to one-shot zstd decode instead of streaming. Expect lower zswap mean/tails, neutral disk; falsified by correctness failure, calibrated guard regression, or improvement inside noise.
candidates.decision_reason: REJECT_FAST: report 15ded9c2bdf44b5fae1b3e83f0f75daf fails all four compressed latency guards; zswap seq mean +24.39%. Both release correctness backends and targeted KASAN/lockdep correctness pass. Disk-path movement has no matching mechanism and is not credited. Retain evidence, no slow tier or promotion.

candidates.name: xs-ra-cluster-v1
candidates.hypothesis: Extend adjacency-gated physical xswap readahead to the actual rotational cluster mode, recording demand-miss VMA history without altering global estimator state. Recover disk sequential benefit, retain synchronous discontinuities, leave compressed reads unchanged. Falsified by zero useful prefetch counters or any calibrated latency guard failure.
candidates.decision_reason: REJECT_FAST: report 9ec21a04b74b4d46a7931c16112a6bdb records useful physical prefetch and disk seq mean -40.19%, but disk random p99 +29.46% and compressed random mean +7.96% fail guards. Targeted KASAN/lockdep, both release correctness backends and CONFIG_SWAP=n build pass. Retain the tradeoff; no slow confirmation or promotion. Two pairs leave causal attribution and between-run variation unresolved.

The generator divided retained nanoseconds by 1000; this tree stores the published microsecond values and does not reconstruct nanoseconds. Recount against this tree: 180 strip points; 20 prefetch points match mechanisms.swap_ra_hit and are not repeated here; 80 mean points also match 1e6 divided by descriptive_costs pages per second within 0.01 us; 4 disk-random means also appear in nanoseconds in calibration-diagnosis.json; 80 p99 points have no other source. An earlier audit count of 162 unsourced points does not match this recount.
